AlarmDescription: Fires when the average number of devices with a live heartbeat (derived by scanning Fleexa_Devices for operational_state / last_seen within the expected heartbeat window) drops below 3 for 3 consecutive 5 minute periods. Threshold is sized against the 6 demo devices provisioned by infra-iot-fleet/scripts/register_devices.sh — raise it once the fleet is provisioned at real scale.
